ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sound does the Arabic letter ت make? (1 mark)
   A. a quick rolled r
   B. d as in dog
   C. t as in tap
   D. m as in mat

2. What is the name of the Arabic letter ه? (1 mark)
   A. dhaal
   B. Saad
   C. haa
   D. raa

3. What does the Arabic word أَخٌ (akh) mean? (1 mark)
   A. brother
   B. father's sister
   C. son
   D. mother's brother

4. What does legible mean? (1 mark)
   A. Very small
   B. Easy to read
   C. Very fast
   D. Written in colour

5. How is the Arabic word حَقِيبَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. miftaah
   B. hammaam
   C. bayt
   D. haqiiba

6. How is the Arabic word لَذِيذٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ladhiidh
   B. baarid
   C. taawila
   D. as-salaamu ʿalaykum

7. What does the Arabic sentence الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The door is big.
   B. The window is clean.
   C. The chair is new.
   D. The table is small.

8. Why do people use pictures to communicate? (1 mark)
   A. Pictures can be understood by people who speak different languages
   B. Pictures are always words
   C. Pictures have no meaning
   D. Pictures are only for children

9. Which Arabic word means "day"? (1 mark)
   A. السَّبْتُ
   B. يَوْمٌ
   C. الْأَحَدُ
   D. أَمْسِ

10. What does the Arabic word أُسْبُوعٌ (usbuuʿ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Monday
   C. yesterday
   D. week

11. What does the Arabic word هَدِيَّةٌ (hadiyya) mean? (1 mark)
   A. cake
   B. gift
   C. no
   D. drink

12. Which Arabic word means "drink"? (1 mark)
   A. صَدِيقٌ
   B. شَمْعَةٌ
   C. شَرَابٌ
   D. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ

13. What does the Arabic sentence الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The banana is delicious.
   B. Above the table there is a balloon.
   C. I eat rice.
   D. I drink tea.

14. Which Arabic word means "milk"? (1 mark)
   A. جَزَرٌ
   B. مَوْزٌ
   C. مَاءٌ
   D. حَلِيبٌ

15. What is a stanza? (1 mark)
   A. A spelling test
   B. A group of lines in a poem
   C. A kind of word
   D. A drawing

16. Which Arabic word means "leg"? (1 mark)
   A. بَطْنٌ
   B. رِجْلٌ
   C. ظَهْرٌ
   D. سِنٌّ

17. What does al-jawwu mumtir mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is cold.
   B. The weather is rainy.
   C. The weather is sunny.
   D. The weather is cloudy.

18. Which Arabic word means "clouds"? (1 mark)
   A. سَحَابٌ
   B. نَهْرٌ
   C. نَظِيفٌ
   D. جَبَلٌ

19. What does the Arabic sentence بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My house is big.
   B. In the kitchen there is a table.
   C. This is my room.
   D. In the room there is a bed.

20. What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen there is a table.
   B. I like my house.
   C. In the room there is a bed.
   D. This is my room.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain how the weather affects our daily life. Give two examples. (3 marks) (3 marks)

22. Rearrange the words to make a sentence and translate it: الْخَمِيسِ / يَوْمُ / الْيَوْمُ. (3 marks) (3 marks)

23. Give three checks you should do after writing a sentence in Arabic. (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Write four foods or drinks in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

25. Write four weather features in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

26. Translate into English: ashrabu sh-shaaya (2 marks)

27. Translate into English: haadhihi ghurfatii (2 marks)

28. Explain what makes a paragraph coherent. (2 marks) (2 marks)

29. Translate into English: al-mawzu ladhiidh (2 marks)

30. Translate into English: baytii kabiir (2 marks)

31. Match these to their Arabic names: chair, bed, kitchen. Write the sounds. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — t as in tap
   The letter ت makes the sound t as in tap.

2. C — haa
   The letter ه is called haa.

3. A — brother
   أَخٌ (akh) means brother.

4. B — Easy to read
   Legible writing can be read easily by other people.

5. D — haqiiba
   حَقِيبَةٌ is read haqiiba and means bag.

6. A — ladhiidh
   لَذِيذٌ is read ladhiidh and means delicious.

7. D — The table is small.
   الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ (at-taawilatu Sagiira) means: The table is small.

8. A — Pictures can be understood by people who speak different languages
   A picture can carry a message without words.

9. B — يَوْمٌ
   يَوْمٌ (yawm) means day.

10. D — week
   أُسْبُوعٌ (usbuuʿ) means week.

11. B — gift
   هَدِيَّةٌ (hadiyya) means gift.

12. C — شَرَابٌ
   شَرَابٌ (sharaab) means drink.

13. A — The banana is delicious.
   الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ (al-mawzu ladhiidh) means: The banana is delicious.

14. D — حَلِيبٌ
   حَلِيبٌ (haliib) means milk.

15. B — A group of lines in a poem
   A stanza is like a paragraph in a poem.

16. B — رِجْلٌ
   رِجْلٌ (rijl) means leg.

17. B — The weather is rainy.
   mumtir means rainy.

18. A — سَحَابٌ
   سَحَابٌ (sahaab) means clouds.

19. A — My house is big.
   بَيْتِي كَبِيرٌ (baytii kabiir) means: My house is big.

20. C — In the room there is a bed.
   فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ (fii l-ghurfati sariir) means: In the room there is a bed.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Rain helps crops to grow; hot sun makes us look for shade; we choose our clothes by the weather.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the idea and 1 mark for each example.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ. Today is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first word, 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the translation.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Did I write from right to left? Are the letters neat and joined? Are the dots and marks in place? Does the sentence make sense?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid check.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example khubz (bread), aruzz (rice), maa' (water), haliib (milk).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: shams (sun), sahaab (clouds), riih (wind), matar (rain).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: I drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my room.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sentences are about one topic and are in a good order, so they fit together and make sense.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for one topic and 1 mark for a logical order.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: The banana is delicious.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: My house is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: chair is kursii, bed is sariir, kitchen is matbakh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.
